daily_kpi: The UTC 2026-11-27 minimum was already met by the distinct ETF-relative-flow real-data forecast screen; this is an additional hypothesis backtest.
data_scope: Mempool.space avgFee_75 12h bins, daily median 2023-11-28 to 2026-11-26 (1095 complete dates); Binance BTCUSDT Spot 1d UTC 2023-11-28 to 2026-11-25 (1094 candles); six-calendar-day events; validation 2025-H1; test 2025-H2 onward

BTCUSDT.source: Binance Vision official Spot monthly/daily 1d UTC klines

Mempool_fee_rate.provider: Mempool Open Source Project REST API

summary.daily_aggregation: median of the two 12-hour-bin avgFee_75 averages by UTC date; each bin avgFee_75 is the mean of underlying block p75 values

disposition: INCONCLUSIVE — frozen validation/test and paired-loss rules do not establish incremental predictive value or decisive inferiority
limitations: Mempool's three-year endpoint is current-vintage and does not reconstruct historical API publication timestamps or point-in-time revisions; the frozen one-day embargo does not eliminate all vintage risk.

Each avgFee_75 value is an average of underlying block-level p75 feerates within a 12-hour bin; the daily feature is the median of two bin averages, not the median of all block-level p75 values in a UTC day.
The fee-rate series is a blockspace price/congestion proxy, not a direct measure of transaction count, backlog, exchange flows, investor positioning or forced selling.
The model is a BTC Spot forecast screen, not an executable strategy or P&L. No trading profitability, causal or live-deployment claim is made.
The price series is one venue's BTCUSDT Spot close. The downloaded archive subset was checksum-matched to the previously accepted 2017-08-17 through 2026-11-25 source manifest.
No raw fee-rate or price observations are saved or committed; only hashes, source metadata and aggregate results are retained.

methodology.availability: One full UTC-day embargo; only completed fee-rate dates t-1 and t-8 are used at the close of BTC day t
methodology.target: log1p(mean squared negative BTC daily log returns over t+1 through t+5, multiplied by 10,000; percentage-points-squared units)
methodology.training_rule: latest 65 events whose signal_date and target_end_date are both strictly earlier than the current signal date
